members.title: Judge-Executive
members.status_note: Judge/Executive since 2018 (appointed, then elected in November 2018 and re-elected in 2022). Lost the May 2026 Republican primary; term ends January 3, 2027.

members.title: Magistrate, District 1
members.status_note: Magistrate since January 2023; re-elected unopposed in November 2026 for a term through 2030.

members.title: Magistrate, District 2
members.status_note: Magistrate since January 2015; re-elected in November 2026 for a term through 2030.

members.title: Magistrate, District 3
members.status_note: Magistrate since January 2015. Lost the May 2026 Republican primary to Cole Houston; term ends January 3, 2027.

members.title: Magistrate, District 4
members.status_note: Magistrate since January 2019. Won the Republican primary over Judge/Executive Kenny Imes in May 2026 and the general election on November 3, 2026; becomes Judge/Executive on January 4, 2027.

members.title: Magistrate, District 1 (2019 to 2022)
members.status_note: Magistrate, District 1, January 2019 to December 2022. Did not seek re-election in 2022.

members.title: Magistrate-elect, District 3
members.status_note: Won the May 2026 Republican primary over incumbent Don Cherry and was unopposed in November 2026. Takes office January 4, 2027.

members.title: Magistrate-elect, District 4
members.status_note: Won the open District 4 seat on November 3, 2026 over Davin Tabers. Takes office January 4, 2027.

note: Eddie Clyde Hale served as District 1 magistrate through December 2022; Ricky Stewart took the seat in January 2023. The late Magistrate Johnny Gingles was memorialized by the Court on January 21, 2026. Names verified against the county's elected-officials page and the minutes.
